name: Cryo Mist
description: Hidden nozzles in the ceiling release hyper-cold air, potentially freezing intruders in place.
disable: DC 27 Computers (master) to increase the air's temperature to safe levels, or DC 27 Thievery (master) to deactivate the nozzles

offensiveAbilities.name: Freeze!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves below the nozzles

Effect The trap sprays cold air on the triggering creature, dealing (4d10+26) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and becomes Clumsy 1.

Failure The creature takes full damage, becomes Clumsy 2, and becomes Slowed 1 or 1d4 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, becomes clumsy 2, and becomes Paralyzed for 1 minute. Creatures within 10 feet of the triggering creature take (2d12+13) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
